auxiliary_suffix.reason: Film-forming/viscosity-increasing emollient rank 18 blocks all earlier suffixes, in addition to earlier unresolved preparations. From 19 onward only recognized antioxidant and fragrance auxiliaries remain. Tocopheryl acetate repeats the antioxidant function; fragrance allergens do not add independent functions.

counter_signal: Almond, castor, sunflower and soybean oils are real retained botanical contributors; glycerides have film-forming and viscosity-increasing capability.
base.reason: The coherent early ester/alkane emollient carrier sequence at 1-4, extended by emollient/solvent 6, explains the principal vehicle. Botanical oils and glycerides do not supply affirmative joint principal-backbone evidence sufficient for hybrid. Fixed-oil inventory includes almond 5, castor 9, sunflower 10 and soybean 17. Angelica seed 15 is preparation-unresolved and is not silently counted or excluded as an established fixed oil.
base.unresolved: Relative amounts and ester/alkane grades are unknown. Angelica seed preparation and several botanical functions remain unresolved but do not currently displace the identified principal carrier sequence.

evidence: exact_material_priors: sweet_almond HW001/HW003; castor HW009/HW003; sunflower HW014; soybean HW033
counter_signal: Medium: castor plus retained ester/fatty-alcohol emollients and film-forming/viscosity-increasing glycerides provide the strongest heavier architecture. They are not treated as negligible because they occur later.
Rich: would require castor/glyceride structure to be principal; no grade or whole-system evidence establishes that dominance.
weight.reason: B1/B4: the ordered ester/alkane carrier sequence, supported by emollient solvent and several light-tendency fixed oils, provides a coherent mobile-distribution hypothesis. B6 counter-signals are real, but secondary castor and one later glyceride capability do not establish a principal structured film that outweighs this route. Light narrowly wins; this does not mean all carriers evaporate or leave no residue.
weight.unresolved: Exact amounts, mobility/grade of palmitate esters and alkane, glyceride structure, castor contribution, and unresolved botanical preparations may support medium. No neat-hair sensory comparison validates the blend class.

counter_signal: Transport of individual esters or botanical components is not established by the generic-function packet; penetration cannot be excluded.
penetration_potential.reason: The affirmative ester/alkane emollient system plus retained oils and glyceride film capability supports a surface-led conditioning architecture. No admitted principal positive whole-oil anchor is present; coco-caprylate/caprate and hydrogenated coco-glycerides do not inherit intact-coconut penetration evidence. The judgment rests on the emollient/film backbone, not absence of studies alone.
penetration_potential.unresolved: No exact-formula uptake study, ester transport comparison or normal-dose result. Generic material functions are extrapolated to a mixture; botanical preparation uncertainty lowers confidence.
